operations.recovery: Retain exact source and applied migration history; capture D1 and every R2 byte consistently before changes. The local product archive excludes Base oa_* authority and is not a full installation backup. Restore to separate resources, reissue credentials after 0009, reconcile uncertain notification attempts, then verify identity, public privacy and provider delivery before switching traffic. See docs/data-ownership.md and docs/disposable-install.md. Installation API/provider/signing keys are excluded from portable archives; reconfigure them explicitly. Imported/restored integration events and tracker commands stay held; reconcile uncertain effects before enabling enforcing egress. General tracker sync and automatic publication remain disabled.
